notes.title: Prison Map Is Coming April 20th
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33436799/f0bec0ad3affe1f7208948c7451a95f317449db4.jpg[/img]

[h1]We bribed the Easter bunny to bring you a basket of new content this weekend![/h1]

Not only are we [b]releasing a new map for the game[/b], we're also [b]adding a bunch more destruction[/b]! You can actually [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/886120/announcements/detail/1776011874531367092]destroy most of the walls in a map[/url] now and decide which way is fastest for you and your team.

The map [b]will be published on April 20th[/b] and in light of this happy occasion [b]we shaved the price a bit[/b]. So let your friends know about UpBreakers and while you're at it, come [url=https://discord.gg/upbreakers]join our Discord Server[/url] to be the first to know about new stuff. We're also beta-testing most of our maps beforehand so you will be able to give us your feedback [i]BEFORE[/i] the map is final!


Happy Easter egg hunt!

notes.title: UpDate #3: Prison Map and DESTRUCTION!
notes.content:
We might have teased our next map here and there. So far, we weren't quite at a point to show you pictures, yet. However, today is the day - time for letting you guys and gals know about our progress!

[h1]TEASING SOME LAYOUT[/h1]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33436799/078d16c558f12c8b56776956410de6de50d2bcdb.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33436799/21a150d1b8351e9aa20d9e21a4c2b4e7f9dabea2.jpg[/img][/url] [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33436799/6203138aa903d89384d2afa42e4c92a34e8cae78.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33436799/0cd8393ff71724a8d83e5826d3939d4a871ca00f.jpg[/img][/url] [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33436799/fb95c95210bf4fc48a220957a9db6f6293891c43.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33436799/4689ca54e57ab98f249eac86c7861bc5f50e6645.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]BREAK OUT THE UPBREAKERS[/h1]
The UpBreakers behind barred windows - how could it have come to this? Whatever they did (or didn't do) the objective now is to get out of this fustercluck and back to their dayjobs. Contrary to the houses they normally visit, there are no open doors in the pen so the UpBreakers have to do what they do best: wreak chaos and destruction!

[h1]INTRODUCING THE D.A.S.H.[/h1]
The very highly sophisticated and complex engine behind the acronym [i]D.A.S.H.[/i] (Destroy Any Structure Handling system) was conceived by our mastermind coder and will be implemented with the next huge content update.
Its sole function: [b]MORE destruction, MORE chaos, MORE fun fun fun![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33436799/e049c2e9e815e3ecff8823dd1a2243fa628e6f7a.gif[/img]

[b]You can destroy walls in the game already![/b] But right now this feature is limited to certain walls - the level designer has spoken and so it was. The new update will give you much more freedom to choose your own crazy ways. Basically, you could take down the whole map and never deliver a single box. Won't bring you any points, but you know: it's possible.

[b]We really want to make the [i]D.A.S.H.[/i] known[/b] - the [i]D.A.S.H.[/i] has to be worshiped - the [i]D.A.S.H.[/i] must be obeyed! So, in the prison map, there is no getting around the [i]D.A.S.H.[/i] as there are no paths leading directly to the BOXVAC-4000, no open doors and no windows to simply jump through. Use the [i]D.A.S.H.[/i] wisely for it will reward you. With great [i]D.A.S.H.[/i] comes great destructibilty. Become one with the [i]D.A.S.H.[/i] to finally - and in a deepened voice - say "I'm [i]D.A.S.H.[/i]MAN".

[h1]WHEN WILL THE UPDATE COME[/h1]
We're still working on the map. There are assets yet to be forged, bytes to be coded and lights to be built. However, we feel, we're almost there. And to those of you who don't want to wait that long: We still have open spots in our closed beta (sounds contradictory, I know) and you can apply for it by simply heading over to our [url=http://discord.gg/upbreakers]Discord[/url] and reading more about it in the [i]#announcements[/i] channel.



[b]May the D.A.S.H. be with you.[/b]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33436799/fd95d5123f65c8531e826f7d3daa42036696af22.gif[/img]
[i]hype intensifies[/i]

notes.title: New Map: Xmas Is Here! (1.0.0-3412365)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33436799/d3c5104aa67fba43fca9b39c17b237dcb026a366.png[/img]

Dust the old conifer and hang up yer socks - Christmas is near! We're always saying how excited we are but today marks a new high of excitement: We have finished our second map and it is out today for you to ransack!

Jacky, Jana, Thomas, Lukas and I have been working on this since we launched UpBreakers mid November and [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Swpf3msKtP0]already had a blast play-testing it[/url] with Geruhn and his band of streamers to iron out all the kinks and having a lot of fun doing it.

[h1]So, what can you expect:[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33436799/3979570f32c677aac95f058bc86b8381682ca31a.png[/img]

While Santa is nowhere in sight (the elves suspect an evergrowing addiction to battle royal games) his little helpers take matters in their own hands. Pretty soon artistic differences come to light: What color of paper goes with which box? Should the cookies have chocolate or pink sprinkles? Does the snow taste better white or yellow? Angry and bored with the chores of wrapping, building, baking and packing, they decide to make a wager of who would finish loading the sleigh first...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33436799/dd1106c8c6b4d4ae013b9783871f3cad9d308b80.png[/img]

We hope you'll have as much fun as we were having making it!

Merry Christmas to you all!



[h1]Other things we did in this update:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added: Made the news bulletin diplay multiple entries
[*] Fixed: The pause menu would not work correctly when playing in local splitscreen
[*] Fixed: Players would spawn outside of the map when not having enough spawn points
[*] Added: new selection menu for the play mode
[*] Added: introduced a map selection for the local multiplayer modes and changed how the map gets selected in the online multiplayer lobby
[*] Fixed: when a gesture was interrupted, the interruption was not replicated correctly in some cases
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Lobby Fixes and News Bulletin (1.0.0-3368111)
notes.content:
In Version 1.0.0-3368111 we added a news bulletin in the main menu and did some minor fixing in the lobby:
[list]
[*] We fixed some issues with text style
[*] You can use gestures now (tap or double-tap the D-pad)
[*] You can use the dash now
[/list]

[u]as we said: minor![/u]

[b]So if you feel, your time has been wasted, enjoy this little web-generated poem:[/b]

[i]My love for Upbreakers is so great,
my heart melts for it 'til the dusk of day.
The night downloads when it's away,
waste, update 'til day's dawn. 

Its beauty is great,
Wondering mind 'til it sees,
wait is all I do,
While waiting for the moment, for it to say "I do."[/i]

notes.title: Update #1 - New Content, WhatsApp Sticker, Playdates
notes.content:
[b]Here we are after one week of Early Access. And we got quite a bunch of things to talk about. Christmas holidays are around the corner, there is a thing called WhatsApp Stickers, we are confessing known issues of the current version to you, we will add two new languages very soon [u]and[/u] we want to play UpBreakers with you![/b]


If you're wondering what we're doing since we released UpBreakers about 1 week ago: The very first thing that we did, of course, was opening a bottle of bubbly - humble as we are ːsteamhappyː The initial buzz passed and we noticed that not many things changed. There's still a bunch of stuff to be done until we can call this game truly finished! So, we sat down together and brainstormed our next steps (the details of which we will devulge to you bit by bit). As a result, one of the first things we will be doing next (and are already working on) is some christmasy content - YAY!

[h1]Christmas Content[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33436799/8d22394e45a9e0313358b4bed0afe85089dff7b3.jpg[/img]

[b]We are working on a map that brings the UpBreakers into the christmas world of Santa's helpers[/b] where you find yourself in one of the two fractious elf teams. They once worked together in the same factory but greed and mistrust split them up and made them despise each other.
We plan to have the Christmas map up and running when Steam's winter sale starts and hope you'll still be friends with your loved ones after a round or two!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33436799/d97bdefd911165d97f5979bb03ff70fd577810a2.jpg[/img]

[h1]WhatsApp Stickers[/h1]
[b]WhatsApp Stickers are apparently becoming more and more of a thing now[/b] so who would we be not to hop on that hype train and ride it hard *chooo choooo*. If you want to spread some UpBreakers "love" you can [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=de.bmg.upbreakersstickers]download a nice collection of stickers now from the Google Play Store[/url] and stick it to your best friends or worst enemies!
Let us know what kind of stickers you're missing from the pack since we want to expand it over time!

[h1]Playdates with us, the devs[/h1]
Yes, we know how multiplayer games work. One needs multiple players... concurrently, ideally. Until UpBreakers has enough of those, we want to offer you to challenge us to a match or two in the meantime!
[b]We will warm up a lobby every week-day at around 5.30 (CET)[/b] so feel free to join us there and wreak some havoc! The lobbies can most likely be found under one of the following names: Subpixels, SuperSpaceCat, Max Emm.
For the very rare case of us not being there, please don't despair! Some evenings we might just be out of the office at some fancy champaign and caviar parties with all the big business players.... yes... that's us indies.

Kidding aside, we have some informative stuff, too:

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[b]From now on, we provide a list of known issues here in the communities' message board[/b]. It might not be complete but that's where you can help us! Should you find issues in the game, feel free to report it right there in the post as a comment!
We will also post a list of planned features very soon!

[h1]Translations into Russian and Simplified Chinese[/h1]
Last but not least: Some nice folks at fiverr supplied us with some neat localisation jobs and [b]we will add simplified Chinese and Russian to the list of available ingame languages very soon![/b]


[h1]That's it, folks![/h1]
Enjoy your weekend and spread the word of UpBreakers to your friends. Because multiplayer games are so much richer when playing them together ;)
